dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline-fitted curve along the trailing edge from the apex to the posterior base, indicating moderate falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a broad pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin approximately 50 to 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.15:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a moderate radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak with low longitudinal pixel extension relative to vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 145 degree interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Cyan-green luminescent surface texture and visible polygonal mesh facets, particularly at the pectoral fin and peduncle margins.
